General_Description.Text: A method for ultrafast tissue clearing that preserves fluorescence for multimodal and longitudinal brain imaging. (2022). Evidence category: method. This card preserves the evidence layer's structured statements and their original field labels; it does not add a new literature review or certify benchmark scoring thresholds.
Text_Reference: Evidence-layer structured paraphrase; not a verbatim quotation. Source release: https://github.com/404NotFound422/TOCAgentProject/tree/5e3a711befb3952a2e39f4d53fc9c9f1a7ac0d22/KnowledgeBase/evidence_expansion_20261019

Application.Text1:
scientific_units:
unit_id: U01
sample_scope: fixed mouse and human tissue
stage: method_identity
statement: AKS alkaline aqueous RI-matching method; pH10.5,RI1.47 at25°C; paper published29March2022. Not M_N0071/FOCM original paper.
source_locator: Par20; article header

Application.Text2:
scientific_units:
unit_id: U02
sample_scope: AKS formulation
stage: reagent
statement: Reported40%v/v TDE,20%v/v DMSO,20%w/v sorbitol,6%w/v Tris equivalent0.5M; comparison component combinations support RI effect but no universal tissue-clearing predictor established.
source_locator: Par20–21,41; Fig1A

sample_scope: fixed mouse brain100µm
stage: RI_matching
statement: Reported clear within2min; transmission increased in cortex and anterior commissure; n4 for transmittance and n3 representative slices.
source_locator: Par21; Fig1C/D; TableS2
duration_scope: clearing_stage

source_locator: Par21,42; Fig1A/B; TableS1
denominator: PBS preclearing size=100%
duration_scope: clearing_stage

stage: fluorescence_comparison
statement: CUBIC-1,ScaleSQ(5),FOCM,AKS compared at10min and24h using same imaging parameters and same position; tdTomato,ChR2-EYFP,YFP; n3 per condition. Slide adhesion reduces deformation confound; does not measure protein mass retention.
